import json
from fractions import Fraction as F

# Fold line = perpendicular bisector of A and B: a*x + b*y + c = 0
A = (F(1), F(3)); B = (F(5), F(1))
a = B[0] - A[0]
b = B[1] - A[1]
mx = (A[0] + B[0]) / 2
my = (A[1] + B[1]) / 2
c = -(a * mx + b * my)

def reflect(P):
    d = (a * P[0] + b * P[1] + c) / (a * a + b * b)
    return (P[0] - 2 * a * d, P[1] - 2 * b * d)

# Verify the fold maps A to B
assert reflect(A) == B

p, q = reflect((F(8), F(4)))
s = p + q

options = {"A": F(92, 10), "B": F(93, 10), "C": F(28, 3), "D": F(94, 10), "E": F(95, 10)}
match = [k for k, v in options.items() if v == s]

result = {
    "final_answer": str(float(s)) if not match else match[0],
    "evidence": {
        "fold_line": f"{a}x+{b}y+{c}=0",
        "p": str(p), "q": str(q), "p+q": str(s),
        "matching_options": match,
    },
}
print(json.dumps(result))
